description: Renewal handoff for the opum-marketplace worker session, written at the leader's instruction before renewal. One authoritative implementation note carries the state and the pending ruling; this description only points at it.
implementationNotes:
Renewal handoff, 2026-10-20, written at the leader's instruction before renewal. This is the authoritative note; the TS-24 notes carry the measurements and the verdicts.

STATE, read with rev-parse at 07:1xZ, not remembered: opum-marketplace dev = origin/dev = 8eac0f61ec8b3f6878fcca104bfeacae22b25217; test-skills dev = origin/dev = 7ddb5ac6799b645d4e309b5f6e83732b5fb01c25. Both trees clean apart from the untracked .claude/worktrees/ directories. Nothing is uncommitted; nothing is unpushed; no PR is open from me.

PENDING RULING, the one thing that matters next. DEC-195 (7)(c) is with opum-doc as an A/B relayed by the leader: A = max_tests 84 -> 95 (eleven slots, my recommendation, the cases that earned a kill); B = 84 -> 94 (the stricter reading, cases that kill their own stated target, which drops the prune case). DO NOT amend until the ruling comes back, and the amendment itself comes back to the leader for opum-doc. The measured basis: (7)(b) took the suite from 295 to 323 kills (+28) for 13 proposed cases, digest 222210827aa01053cd8fc32c56202671a4b1467dfb8f64cd844f5eb0aecd6bae, 26 kills attributable per case and 2 unattributed. Eleven cases earned a slot; two earned none (the incumbent/exhaustion case, target still unreached; the corrupt-base-state case, reached but surviving). The prune case kills cover.py:72 rather than its own target cover.py:75, because _greedy only seeds the branch and bound.

FOLDED AND DONE, for context only. (7)(a) landed as opum-ai/test-skills#33 (squash b111a034), the seven existing tests extended with no new collected cases: 274 -> 295 kills at the same digest, 14 of 14 targeted lines killed, collected count still 84. Its Stage 1 verdict is on TS-24 verbatim with model, SHA and sha256. (7)(b) was measured on a local-only scratch branch that has been DELETED and never pushed; the matrices survive as .tmx/ts24-scratch-13cases.json and .tmx/ts24-scratch-13cases-run1.json (gitignored, as every .tmx artifact is).

UNSTARTED, in this order. TS-30: the gate reads an unreadable quarantine or probation state file as empty (fail-open), found by the #33 review. Its description quotes the verdict verbatim and decides NOTHING about whether fail-open is intended; that decision is the task's first job, routed to opum-doc through the leader if the code does not answer it, and the assertion at test_gate_matrix.py:56-59 must be inverted only if fail-open is not intended. TS-29: nested test classes undercount to a false refusal (fails closed), the surviving baseline-only-scope mutant, and the narrow union case. Any test either task needs is a measured slot request to the leader, sized with the outcomes, never assumed.

WORKTREES, LEFT IN PLACE DELIBERATELY under DEC-208: nothing is removed until LCLI-740 ships. test-skills holds review-23-1c08492 (1c08492), test-skills-review-14 (888410c) and review-33-bc8e22f (bc8e22f, the landed #33 read tree). opum-marketplace holds the unit root review-ts27-6d10d27 (8eac0f6). The stranded .lore-only review-ts25-1c08492 directory also stays until the LCLI-740 cache-clear; it is not registered.

STANDING RULES LEARNED THIS SESSION, now in memory as well as here. A cap or constitution change goes to the leader before it lands, even when Article XIII's own order seems to require landing it. A mutation proof must clear __pycache__ on both arms, because a one-character restore is the same size and a same-second write reuses the mutated bytecode. Never complete a short SHA by hand: read headRefOid, because a guessed tail is refused as "Head branch was modified". And the measured with/without delta is the only kill number to trust; killed_by lists are not exhaustive.

SKILLS for the successor: opum-sdlc, lore, quest, opum-handoff.
